note: Sound by zone (Sound job, 11 Nov; made by Claude Code, Cursor's to tune). layers: how loud each ambience layer is in the zone (0 to 1.5): waves (sea and gulls), street (hum, a hooter, a passing engine), wind, murmur (voices through a wall), crowd (the crowd recording). music: the track by part of the day (meta.json phase ids), else default. Tracks: music_campus, alt_slow_tar, alt_sunday_braai, alt_kasi_morning, alt_golden_hour (public/audio). 'inside' is any place you walk into in SunnyBay or a house on campus: its layers replace the zone's, the music carries on.
note2: Job L (13 Nov): music by zone, one track at a time with cross-fades. musicLevel scales the track (1 = its own volume). The Caf light background, the Quad (campus) a soft radio, the bowling and arcade hall upbeat but quieter (places.arcade), the beach and the streets no music (city.* have none), home (a house's common room) the player's own choice (menu: Home music). caps: the most any layer may be, so crowds murmur and never scream.
